title: Bird: cleaner horns and muzzle
kaylee: Uncle Bird looks tidier: smooth curved horns like your bull picture, a smaller rounded snout with nostrils, rounder ears and a smooth hairline.
questions: The other buffaloes (BB, Lung Kwai, the mushroom farmer, the bay fisherman) got the same horns and snout. Keep it for all?
